The buyer is likely to prevail because the custom-made shutters were fixtures—annexed by screws and brackets and adapted to the home—and thus conveyed with the realty under the warranty deed, even though the sales agreement did not mention them. The man's removal and repair of the window frames does not defeat the buyer's claim, as fixtures pass with the land unless expressly excluded. The buyer's failure to inspect does not waive the right to fixtures included in the sale.

CONFIDENCE: 55
